---
name: Correction
about: Correct a date, name, number, or reading in the archive
title: "Correction: "
labels: ["correction"]
---

## File

For example, `stories/anecdotes.md` or `timeline.md`.

## What it says now

Quote the sentence.

## What it should say

Your wording.

## Source

A link that supports the change.

## Note

If two good sources disagree, say so. The archive can keep both.
